Lotus Whispers Guided Mindfulness Journal

LOTUS WHISPERS — Within & Between A Guided Mindfulness & Reflection Journal Words by Monika Chugh · Art by Alka Chopra · Mindful Seeker Series.

Rooted in the symbolism of the lotus, a flower that rises through still water and unfolds in its own time, this is not a journal to perform or perfect. It's a sanctuary for the thoughts, emotions, and truths that have simply been waiting to be seen.

Author & ThinkerMonika Chugh
My Story

Weaving Words, Emotion, and Timeless Wisdom

Monika Chugh is a celebrated author, poet, and speaker whose works explore the subtle intersections of human soul, resilience, and creative expression.

"Words are not merely symbols on parchment; they are the quiet whispers of our deepest truths."

— Monika Chugh

Through books, essays, and public discourses, Monika invites readers on a journey of self-discovery, spiritual harmony, and artistic mindfulness.
